why: Episodes that exist in curation/source/feeds/ but never reached the labelled corpus. Two causes. (1) The 2026-07 theming run filtered its input to episodeType == 'full', dropping every bonus and trailer -- and bonus is where podcasts publish their multi-part mini-series, so it removed precisely the narrative arcs this catalog exists to surface (99% Invisible's '100 Objects #1..#9' are all bonus). (2) 12 shows were never themed at all, and a further ~670 'full' episodes went missing in scattered holes, consistent with rows lost between batches of a batched run. feeds/ is gitignored, so committing these here keeps the build reproducible from tracked data. They carry no subjects: Phase 3 labels them.
